site.name: Digitized Christian Works
site.description: A growing library of historic Christian works, restored for digital reading today and, one day, for our bookshelves.

works.author: Henry Alford
works.title: The New Testament for English Readers
works.description: A critical and explanatory commentary on the New Testament for English readers.

works.author: John Saul Howson
works.title: The Companions of St. Paul
works.description: Studies of Barnabas, Lydia, Luke, and other people who accompanied Paul in his ministry and travels.

works.author: Philip Schaff
works.title: A Popular Commentary on the New Testament
works.shortTitle: Popular Commentary on the New Testament
works.description: An interdenominational commentary on the New Testament edited by Philip Schaff, in four volumes covering the Gospels, Acts, the Epistles of Paul and Hebrews through Revelation.

works.author: W. J. Conybeare and J. S. Howson
works.title: The Life and Epistles of St. Paul
works.shortTitle: The Life and Epistles of St. Paul
works.description: A historical and biographical study of Paul, with the authors' own translation of his letters. Originally published in two volumes.

works.author: Augustus Neander
works.title: General History of the Christian Religion and Church
works.shortTitle: General History of the Christian Religion
works.description: Neander's history of Christianity and the church from the apostolic age to the eve of the Reformation, in Joseph Torrey's American translation, in five volumes with the separate 1881 General Index volume.

works.author: Christopher Wordsworth
works.title: A Church History
works.description: Bishop Wordsworth's history of the Church from its founding to the Council of Chalcedon, A.D. 451, in four volumes, with the general index to the whole work in the fourth.

works.author: Robert Jamieson, A. R. Fausset, and David Brown
works.title: Commentary Critical and Explanatory on the Whole Bible
works.description: The whole-Bible commentary commonly known as Jamieson-Fausset-Brown, in the abridged one-volume edition with its engraved plates and the Dictionary of Scripture Proper Names, set as two volumes: the Old Testament, and the New Testament with the Dictionary.

works.author: John Wesley
works.title: Explanatory Notes upon the Bible
works.description: Wesley's concise notes on the whole Bible, set with the Scripture text and marginal cross-references. The Old Testament comes from the Bristol quarto of 1765 in three volumes, and the New Testament from Wesley's revised text as the fourth.

works.author: Marvin R. Vincent
works.title: Word Studies in the New Testament
works.shortTitle: Word Studies in the New Testament
works.description: Vincent's four-volume study of the Greek words of the New Testament, book by book, with notes on language, translation and interpretation and full English and Greek indexes.
works.originalPublication: New York, Charles Scribner's Sons, 1887 plates (1897 and 1900 printings)

works.author: C. F. Keil and Franz Delitzsch
works.title: Biblical Commentary on the Old Testament
works.description: Keil and Delitzsch's verse-by-verse commentary on the whole Old Testament from the Hebrew, in the 25-volume English translation of Clark's Foreign Theological Library, with introductions, notes and indexes.

plannedWorks.author: Johann Peter Lange
plannedWorks.title: A Commentary on the Holy Scriptures
plannedWorks.description: A multi-volume theological and homiletical commentary on the Bible.

plannedWorks.author: John Calvin
plannedWorks.title: Calvin's Commentaries
plannedWorks.description: Calvin's commentaries on most books of the Bible. We will cover every commentary except Genesis and Daniel, which Banner of Truth still sells.

plannedWorks.author: William Kelly
plannedWorks.title: Bible Commentaries
plannedWorks.description: Kelly's expositions of books of the Bible. We will cover only the titles no publisher currently sells, such as Isaiah, Ezekiel, the Minor Prophets, Acts, Romans and Galatians.

skippedWorks.author: A. B. Simpson
skippedWorks.title: The Names of Jesus
skippedWorks.description: A sixteen-chapter study of names and titles of Jesus.
skippedWorks.skipReason: Still sold by Moody Publishers as a WingSpread ebook.

skippedWorks.author: William Mitchell Ramsay
skippedWorks.title: St. Paul the Traveller and the Roman Citizen
skippedWorks.description: A historical and geographical study of Paul's travels and Roman setting.
skippedWorks.skipReason: Still sold by Kregel in a revised edition.

skippedWorks.author: Augustine of Hippo
skippedWorks.title: On the Trinity
skippedWorks.description: Augustine's theological treatise on the Christian doctrine of the Trinity.
skippedWorks.skipReason: Modern translations are still sold by Catholic University of America Press and New City Press.

skippedWorks.author: Robert Govett
skippedWorks.title: The Twofoldness of Divine Truth
skippedWorks.description: An examination of paired and seemingly contrasting truths in Scripture.

skippedWorks.author: G. Campbell Morgan
skippedWorks.title: An Exposition of the Whole Bible
skippedWorks.description: A chapter-by-chapter exposition of the Bible in one volume.

skippedWorks.author: Martin Luther
skippedWorks.title: Commentary on Galatians
skippedWorks.description: Luther's exposition of Paul's Epistle to the Galatians.
skippedWorks.skipReason: Still sold by Crossway in its Classic Commentaries series.

skippedWorks.author: Alexander Balmain Bruce
skippedWorks.title: The Training of the Twelve
skippedWorks.description: A study of Christ's preparation of the twelve disciples for their work.
skippedWorks.skipReason: Still sold by Kregel in a 2020 edition.

skippedWorks.author: Eusebius of Caesarea
skippedWorks.title: Preparation for the Gospel
skippedWorks.description: Eusebius's apologetic work preserved in the complete Gifford translation.
skippedWorks.skipReason: Wipf & Stock still sells Gifford's translation new, in one volume and in a recent two-volume paperback and hardcover edition.

skippedWorks.author: John Gill
skippedWorks.title: Exposition of the Whole Bible
skippedWorks.description: A phrase-by-phrase exposition of the whole Bible, published from 1746 to 1766.
skippedWorks.skipReason: The Baptist Standard Bearer still sells the complete nine-volume set new in hardback, paperback and ebook.

skippedWorks.author: Albert Barnes
skippedWorks.title: Barnes' Notes on the Bible
skippedWorks.description: Barnes' extensive explanatory notes on the Old and New Testaments.
skippedWorks.skipReason: Life Sentence Publishing (Aneko Press) is selling a new edition in paperback and Kindle, released book by book since 2024.

skippedWorks.author: Archibald Thomas Robertson
skippedWorks.title: Word Pictures in the New Testament
skippedWorks.description: A six-volume study of New Testament language and interpretation.
skippedWorks.skipReason: B&H Publishing is releasing a new 100th anniversary edition on November 1, 2026.

skippedWorks.author: Arthur W. Pink
skippedWorks.title: Gleanings in Genesis, Exodus, and Joshua
skippedWorks.description: Pink's chapter-based expositions of Genesis, Exodus, and Joshua.
skippedWorks.skipReason: Moody Publishers and Wakeman Trust still sell these books new.

skippedWorks.author: Henri L. Rossier
skippedWorks.title: Commentary on the Historical Books
skippedWorks.description: Rossier's expositions of the historical books of the Old Testament.
skippedWorks.skipReason: Believers Bookshelf still sells these books, and most English translations are modern and under copyright.

skippedWorks.author: Charles A. Coates
skippedWorks.title: Commentaries, Letters, and Tracts
skippedWorks.description: Coates' collected chapter-based expositions and other biblical writings.
skippedWorks.skipReason: Kingston Bible Trust still sells the Outlines series new.

skippedWorks.author: Charles H. Mackintosh
skippedWorks.title: Notes on the Pentateuch
skippedWorks.description: A six-volume exposition of the five books of Moses.
skippedWorks.skipReason: Believers Bookshelf still sells a new six-volume set.

skippedWorks.author: C. I. Scofield
skippedWorks.title: Scofield Reference Notes
skippedWorks.description: The explanatory notes from the Scofield Reference Bible.
skippedWorks.skipReason: Oxford University Press still sells the 1917 Scofield notes.

skippedWorks.author: Robert Govett
skippedWorks.title: The Parables of the Kingdom
skippedWorks.description: An exposition of the parables concerning the kingdom of heaven.
skippedWorks.skipReason: Schoettle Publishing still sells Govett on the Parables new.

skippedWorks.author: Robert Govett
skippedWorks.title: The Apocalypse Expounded by Scripture
skippedWorks.description: A verse-by-verse exposition of the book of Revelation.
skippedWorks.skipReason: Schoettle Publishing still sells Govett on Revelation new.
